rules.title: Learner conditions come with the licence
rules.summary: A learner should follow the conditions printed with the learner licence and all applicable road rules.

rules.title: Display the required learner marking
rules.summary: Follow the applicable requirement for displaying the learner identification marking on the vehicle.

rules.title: Use the correct vehicle class
rules.summary: Practice only in a vehicle appropriate to the vehicle class covered by the learner licence.

rules.title: Carry the learner licence as required
rules.summary: Keep the learner licence/reference available as required by the applicable rules and official process.

rules.title: Follow the accompanying-driver requirement
rules.summary: Where the learner conditions require a duly licensed person to accompany the learner, comply with that requirement.

rules.title: Do not treat practice as a licence to ignore road rules
rules.summary: A learner has to obey the same applicable traffic controls and road-safety requirements while practising.

rules.title: Study before the preliminary test
rules.summary: The preliminary test checks knowledge areas including traffic signs, signals, accident duties and documents.

rules.title: Use the current official State/UT process
rules.summary: Online services and their exact workflow can be adapted by States/UTs, so verify the selected jurisdiction before applying.

rules.title: Keep application references safe
rules.summary: Retain application number and appointment details for later status, printing or service actions when issued.

rules.title: Check the learner licence before the driving test
rules.summary: Before moving to the competence test, confirm that the learner licence is valid and covers the intended class.
